title: "Reference Counting with Rc and Arc"

# Reference Counting with Rc and Arc
When multiple parts of a program need shared read ownership of heap memory:
- `Rc<T>`: Single-threaded reference counting.
- `Arc<T>`: Atomic reference counting across multiple threads.

```rust
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::thread;

fn main() {
    let data = Arc::new(vec![1, 2, 3]);

    let data_clone = Arc::clone(&data);
    let handle = thread::spawn(move || {
        println!("Thread sees: {:?}", data_clone);
    });

    handle.join().unwrap();
    println!("Main sees: {:?}", data);
}
```
